hypothesis: After timing-003 the VALU's integer reduction is still the device's worst path, and four of its five nanoseconds are the min/max tournament: four 32-bit compares in series, each steering a 32-bit mux with fan-out 32-65. Comparing every pair of lanes once, in parallel, and picking the winner one-hot makes it one compare deep without moving a cycle.
evidence_for_hypothesis: tnca_fpga_top post-synthesis, 6.667 ns target, after timing-003: w_class -> w_sdata 7.759 ns / 32 levels; the max tree is 1.0 -> 6.0 ns of it (four CARRY8 compare levels plus the 32-65 fan-out muxes)

microarch.change: min/max reduction as VLEN*(VLEN-1)/2 parallel key compares; lane i wins if its key is above every lower lane's and at least every higher lane's (exactly one winner, the lowest-numbered maximum), result picked by a one-hot AND-OR; inactive lanes keep key 0, so the empty mask still yields the identity
